issues.quote: PARTIAL (۶.۵.۲؛ هفت گزینه در برابر چهار گزینهٔ NIST)
issues.explanation: The claim «چهار گزینهٔ NIST» is a factual statement about the count of treatment options in NIST AI RMF MANAGE 1.3. No NIST evidence item is cited in the evidence list for this section; all cited items are INSO standard items. The count is therefore not supported by any cited evidence. The corresponding «هفت گزینه» for INSO 23733 §6.5.2 is correctly supported by S23733-115 which lists seven options.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the NIST option count from the table cell, or rephrase as an explicit compiler note referencing the E1 chapter: e.g., «PARTIAL (۶.۵.۲؛ هفت گزینه؛ مقایسه با گزینه‌های NIST ← C10-S03)» — keeping the INSO clause reference intact while directing readers to the E1 NIST chapter for the comparison count.
